en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large concert hall building in a park-like setting. The structure has an ornate façade with many windows, decorative reliefs, and a lower veranda or terrace in front furnished with tables and chairs. A taller tower-like section rises on the left. Mature trees frame the scene, a fence and walkway run along the foreground, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing are visible. Caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
